description: PyProBE is a Python package for reproducible processing of battery experiments. It loads test data, organizes procedures and metadata, supports fast table operations with Polars, and provides plots and post-processing methods. The tested cells, laboratory location and time period are supplied by the researcher; the package is not a field battery dataset. The public repository and documentation are BSD-3-Clause. Its processed capacity, efficiency and ageing measures can help calibrate battery models used in electric-vehicle or grid-storage simulations. A caveat is that experiment labels and measurement conditions need careful recording, and laboratory findings may not transfer directly to a full pack under real operation. No catalogue record or first-review draft matched this named software. The JOSS summary and own repository were read without obtaining experimental files or executing a processing workflow. Geographic coverage is the laboratory or programme that produced the tests. No directly related catalogue record was established.
